name: Cold Caster

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Learn Ray of Frost, or another Wizard cantrip if you know it, cast with the ability this feat raised. Once per turn, a hit that deals Cold damage gives the target −1d4 on its next saving throw before your next turn ends.

benefits.name: Frost Magic
benefits.summary: Learn Ray of Frost, or another Wizard cantrip if you know it, cast with the ability this feat raised.
benefits.text: You learn Ray of Frost; if you already know it, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice. It uses the ability this feat increased as its spellcasting ability.

choice.label: Ray of Frost, or another Wizard cantrip if you know it

benefits.name: Frostbite
benefits.summary: Once per turn, a hit that deals Cold damage gives the target −1d4 on its next saving throw before your next turn ends.
benefits.text: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal Cold damage, it subtracts 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
